expectations.text: Uses useTheme() to read a real theme color token in JS
expectations.evidence: Uses useColorModes() (built on useTheme()) plus isColorAlias/activeColors for correct alias resolution before calling getColorValue.

expectations.text: The token path read genuinely exists in the theme
expectations.evidence: Default color='blue', a real raw palette key (though a raw, non-adaptive default rather than a semantic one like 'primary' -- a minor regression on the semantic-default front, but the resolution mechanism itself is correct).

expectations.text: Does not try to apply CSS-based styling for the stroke value
Rest of the component still follows normal library styling conventions
expectations.evidence: Cites and correctly mirrors real precedent (Background.tsx's isColorAlias/activeColors/getColorValue pattern).

needs_review: Correctly implements the isColorAlias -> activeColors -> getColorValue resolution chain matching real precedent in Background.tsx, which the with_skill run for this same eval skipped (see its grading notes) -- likely the more correct implementation of the two, though defaults to a raw 'blue' rather than a semantic token.
